# Issue #81 independent proactive visual QA

Reviewed issue: [Authorize processing from a validated source and exact selected-section quote](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/81). Reviewer: **GPT-6.1 Sol, High**, dedicated to #81 only. Date: 2026-10-25 (Asia/Qyzylorda). Review only; no acceptance/status change is made.

## Verdict and evidence boundary

**5 findings: 0 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 2 LOW.** The mock upload-to-current-quote journey works in the exercised browser path. The most important visual problem is that this media-selection workspace behaves like a long form: its interval and price are initially out of sight, while two separate sliders do not show the promised interval on one stable source timeline. The 28px desktop paid-action button follows the approved compact reference, but is a poor hierarchy/target decision for this screen.

Baseline HEAD was `9d286621177200fdb5f61ef963d0b6818ae76774`. Existing uncommitted documentation, skills and evidence were present and preserved. `git diff --name-only -- frontend` was empty at completion. Only this issue-81 directory was written. Contracts were the fresh closed issue snapshot in `../contracts/issue-81.md` (zero discussion comments), Flow 06, shared tokens, Affect adoption/catalog/workflow and the supplied review packet. Serena instructions, Ponytail full, spec-task-review and both design skills/app-screen guidance were read. Owner-selected Clean/Light and Mabry took precedence over generic design-skill directions.

Fresh Chromium **156.0.8078.4**, Windows, headless Playwright, DPR1, default browser zoom, isolated local mock Vite **127.0.0.1:4381**, explicit frontend cwd. Fake media device/UI flags and `--mute-audio` were used; page videos were muted. No physical microphone or speaker was used. No full suite or production requests were run.

`capture.cjs` completed the ordinary app path through visible local-mock registration, file input, playable short-source rejection, eligible fixture validation, and exact quote. `supplement.cjs` used the existing `workspace-state-visual` harness for bounded failure/recovery and localization inspection. It overrides identity/project/source/quote/preview services with synthetic responses, seeds sessionStorage's current-project identity, and uses `/media/source-dialogue.mp4`; the harness's **2/6 or 6/6 capacities and fixed 8-credit quotes are fixture values, not real product limits or pricing proof**. No harness result establishes service persistence, conversion fidelity or billing. A successful synthetic field save used the existing override, not the real ledger. The first ordinary-app journey's source facts/default 8.625s and quote9 came through the actual mock facade.

Evidence: [raw metrics](metrics.json), [capture log](capture.log), [capture script](capture.cjs), [supplement script](supplement.cjs), [fresh screenshot manifest](screenshot-manifest.json). There are **20 review screenshots**, all opened and visually inspected with view_image; old screenshots were not reused. Screenshots 03/19 include a transient native-media loading presentation and are not proof that visible video frames were ready. Some full-page captures show the skip link while focus/scroll position changed; this review makes no product finding from that capture artifact.

## Job, source map, and measured facts

An authenticated owner must choose a valid video, understand which original-source interval will be processed, understand the exact spendable-credit cost, then deliberately authorize that processing once. Source preservation and failed-action recovery protect work and money.

Compact desktop values are followed, and critiqued below. |

## Findings

### QA-81-01 — MEDIUM — Two independently scaled sliders do not represent one selected interval

**Class:** confirmed implementation defect. **Affected:** AC-03, AC-07, AC-VIS-01; Flow06 §4.5.

**Reproduce:** Open a saved source; edit Start to0.123 and blur. Inspect both slider tracks and their DOM min/max values. The top track is start0–7.000; the bottom track is end1.123–8.625, even though both have the same960px width. They have no visible Start/End labels beside the tracks, no complete-source ruler and no highlighted selected band connecting the boundaries.

**Expected versus actual:** [Flow06:218](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/_docs/frontend-flows/06-new-dub.md:218) requires one synchronized section-selection control representing the complete source and selected contiguous interval. Actual [NewDubScreen.tsx:1480](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/new-dub/NewDubScreen.tsx:1480) and [1491](/D:/Program/python/Dubbed/frontend/src/features/new-dub/NewDubScreen.tsx:1491) render two independent native ranges whose domains depend on the other boundary. Metrics22 proves the unequal domains. Numbers synchronize, but visual positions do not share a time coordinate system.

**Impact/interpretation:** The owner must infer which slider changes which edge and cannot see the selected portion of the original source. A fixed point on one track means a different source time than the same point on the other; changing one boundary changes the other track's scale. This is especially weak for precisely selecting a scene.

**Recommendation:** Keep the text fields and millisecond validation, but draw both boundaries and a selected band on one stable full-source track; visibly label each edge and expose both accessible names/value text. Do not change rounding or source minimum policy. **Next validation:** drag/keyboard each boundary, compare fields/persisted milliseconds and screen coordinates at two intervals and after the opposite edge moves, in EN/RU desktop/phone.
